english.title: Possess firearm and suitable ammunition in public place
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, had with you in a public place, namely **(..SPECIFY PUBLIC PLACE..)

(A)_[a loaded firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FIREARM..),]_
(B)_[an unloaded firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FIREARM..),]_
(C)_[a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FIREARM..), whether loaded or not]_

together with ammunition suitable for use in the said firearm
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19 of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording is obsolete, see H4711. With effect from 20th January 2004 the "unloaded/ loaded" options are inserted into section 19 of the Act by section 37(1)(c) of the Anti-social Behaviour Act 2003.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H494.
(iii) On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
(iv) See also Home Office Guidance on Firearms Licensing Law.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
